build_visual_net: build a visual feature extraction network using a pretrained ResNet18 backbone
build_audio_net: build a 5-layer U-Net audio network with configurable feature channels and input/output dimensions
build_visual_with_weights: build a visual network and load pretrained weights from a specified checkpoint file
build_audio_with_weights: build an audio U-Net network and load pretrained weights from a specified checkpoint file
review_modelbuilder_class: review the ModelBuilder class and its build_visual and build_audio methods for the 2.5D visual sound model
